tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the public SYMONE documentation (service, prices, FAQ, contact, legal pages, developer portal, API, MCP servers) and return the best matching sections with their document path and URL.

tools.name: fetch_doc
tools.description: Return the full Markdown text of one SYMONE documentation page, by the path returned by search_docs (e.g. "api/index.md") or its https://symone.fr URL.
